column1: # flow/2_static/renames.tsv - the zero-waiver renames (HAL ALOWID, DIFCLK, DIFRST, IDLENG, NUMSUF,
# LCVARN, KEYWOD, AMSKWD), applied by tools/rename_rtl.py. Karthik's ruling 2026-11-16: rename to
# HAL's defaults. A clock or reset has one name through every port it passes:
#   refclk, ext_rst_n (pads; the TAP reset too)   hclk, hreset_n (AHB)   pclk, preset_n (APB)
#   gclk, core_rst_n (core pipeline and DSU)      tck, dm_rst_n (debug)  aon_clk
# ---- generated: the direction suffix dropped from clock and reset ports ----
# ---- the core: free clock hclk at its top, gated clock gclk below the gate ----
# ---- the DSU, inside the core's EX stage ----
# ---- the watchdog runs on the hclk-synchronised external reset, ext_hrst_n ----
# ---- the core reset request drives the synchroniser clear under one name ----
# ---- IDLENG: module names 4 to 16 characters (files renamed to match) ----
# ---- KEYWOD / AMSKWD: VHDL and AMS reserved words ----
# ---- NUMSUF: no numeric suffix (the DSU's accumulators by their spec names) ----
